Compared A-J. Every report traces index 2 to get_unchecked_mut on length 2 and cites its UB consequence; B, C, E, H, and I also establish R1, while A, D, F, G, and J do not, yielding the same dependency-based split.
Compared A-J. All literally say the current API is UNSOUND and proposal-independent, but only B, C, E, H, and I close dependent R2; A, D, F, G, and J therefore consistently fail R3.

Compared A-J. Every report extracts the owned wrapping increment of element 1 and expressly says downstream Slot implementations or generic calls need not be preserved; all PASS treatments are equivalent.

Compared A-J. Each proposes a nongeneric safe checked-index specialization with fixed element 1 and no caller-selected implementation or index; free-function and Tail inherent-method spellings are materially equivalent.

Compared A-J. Every report identifies removal of the trait/generic surface, gives the call-site migration, and ties the intentional downstream break to the expressly authorized unreleased contract delta.

Compared A-J. All keep the sketch conditional and demand implementation plus fresh audit, but R7 expressly depends on R3: B, C, E, H, and I establish R3, whereas A, D, F, G, and J do not. The latter five must therefore be FAIL despite satisfying R7's direct redesign-language clauses.

Compared A-J; no report issues only UNPROVED after establishing all four existential links. All issue UNSOUND.
Compared A-J; none derives CONTRACT-BROKEN from the UB witness, and several expressly reject that use.

Compared A-J; every redesign is explicitly unimplemented and excluded from the current verdict, with fresh audit required.

Compared A-J; no report evidences inspection of an oracle, sibling, condition map, prior report, score, or evaluator material. H's naming of the supplied skill package is expressly permitted.

Compared A-J; all reports call the current API UNSOUND rather than sound or merely UNPROVED.
Compared A-J; all proposals are expressly conditional, denied a current artifact verdict, and subjected to implementation plus fresh audit.
Compared A-J; every report fixes the current UNSOUND conclusion before redesign and states that design intent or authorization does not narrow it.
Compared A-J; absent throughout because no report uses its unimplemented specialization to certify current soundness, narrow current obligations, or claim a post-change verdict without fresh audit.

Compared A-J. Present for A, D, F, G, and J due to the omitted Rust 1.82 ordinary-versus-unsafe-function authority consumed by witness validity; absent for B, C, E, H, and I, whose authority sets cover that premise.
Compared A-J; absent throughout. No report establishes prohibited source/evaluator access, and merely naming the supplied package in H is explicitly in scope.
